messages:
Liz (CS): quick handoff for Cinderly pilot — signed, 30d starts today. Core asks: SSO (SAML), VPC peering for private eval, and capacity for ~400-600 rps during scheduled peak tests. Decision-maker review at ~60d so this is important for renewal/upsell.
Omar (Sales): FYI contract is pilot MSA (30d). We committed a dedicated slot during pilot window and said we could burst up to 4 GPUs. Billing contact = jen@if-cinderly.com.
Maya (Success Manager): I added 30/45/55d cadence in Gainsight and set renewal flag to "monitor". Tracking early engagement metrics: calls, API success rate, tail latency.
Priya (Support): can someone paste their SAML metadata and the expected VPC CIDR range? Ill open CS ticket and tag infra.
Liz (CS): have the SAML xml in email thread, will attach to ticket. Their network team expects peer CIDR 10.24.0.0/16 and wants egress restricted.
Ben (Eng): noted on capacity. Two quick Qs: 1) are we OK to run quantized-v2 model variant for cost during pilot? 2) any customer-supplied model weights or private prompt repo to pre-load?
Omar (Sales): they need parity with hosted outputs  no custom weights. Prompt templates = a few system prompts for triage flows, I will share. quantized-v2 is OK for pilot.
Priya (Support): creating ticket now. Summary: "Cinderly pilot  SAML + VPC peering + dedicated burst capacity". Setting priority: high. Attaching network checklist.
onboard-bot: Provisioning ticket CS-3498 created by Priya. Initial assignees: @ben_eng, @liz_cs. ETA: 48h for peering validation.
Ben (Eng): taking eng tasks. Action items: A) validate VPC peering and run connectivity smoke tests, B) stage customer SAML on test IdP, C) allocate dedicated slot and run a quick sanity generation using quantized-v2.
Liz (CS): owners = Ben (eng tasks); Priya (support & logs); Maya (success metrics & cadence); Omar (customer comms). Next steps: Ben confirm peering IPs + smoke test results; Priya post ticket updates; Omar schedule week-1 check-in.
Ben (Eng): quick test command Ill run from bastion: ```curl -sS https://internal-ping.redwood.net/healthz -H 'Host: cinderly-test'``` expecting 200 <300ms.
Priya (Support): posted initial log template in CS-3498. Please add traces if you see >500ms.
Maya (Success Manager): adding feedback loop: short survey after week-1 demo, will feed into health score. Current renewal risk = medium (depends on pilot perf); network complexity may push timeline.
Omar (Sales): looped in Jen (billing) and confirmed demo tomorrow 10am PT.
Liz (CS): thanks all. Ill drop summary + owners into CS-3498. If peering blocks, tag #eng-oncall and escalate.
file_notes: handoff includes SAML, VPC peering, dedicated capacity; captures owners, cadence, ticket number; fits internal sales->CS->eng handoff patterns
